sources.title: MameLoshnLM: Yiddish Language Model and Evaluation Benchmark
sources.snippet: We present MameLoshnLM, the first open-source 8B-parameter language model built specifically for Yiddish. Despite Yiddish's rich textual tradition, its limited digital presence and the scarcity of reliable evaluation resources have constrained progress in Yiddish language modeling.
